Payslip Summary

The Payslip Summary form configures parameters for payroll summary reports.

Set date ranges to analyze employee earnings, deductions, and contributions.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report, such as 'Monthly Payroll Summary' or 'Q1 Payroll Report'.

From

Select the starting date for the period you want to report on. This will include all payslips dated on or after this date.

To

Select the ending date for the period you want to report on. This will include all payslips dated on or before this date.
